name: Omacore
author: Biraj
description: Battery, ANC modes, sound effects, EQ transfer, button controls, LDAC status and device settings for Soundcore earbuds in the Omarchy bar, via the OpenSCQ30 CLI. Installs with explicit confirmation.

barWidget.description: Per-pod and case battery, ambient sound modes, Sound Effects, EQ preset transfer, button controls, device preferences, information, LDAC status and the computer's playback codec.

schema.label: Bar battery display (0: icon, 1: lowest, 2: all)
Preferred Soundcore device
schema.description: Match part of the Bluetooth name or MAC address; empty uses the first connected Soundcore device.

schema.label: Hide the icon when the earbuds are unreachable
Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify when the earbuds disconnect or a bud/case battery drops to 20% or below.
